---
title: "10 · Reinforcement Learning for Quantum State Preparation"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

We first develop reinforcement learning through states, actions, rewards, returns, policies and the Bellman equation. We show a changing Q-table, Q-learning, Double Q-learning, replay, target networks, DQN and Double DQN, followed by policy gradient, reward-to-go, REINFORCE, actor–critic and PPO. Quantum state preparation is then the implementation example. We state the target-state objective and introduce the action, matrices and exponential generators of H, T, CNOT, single-qubit rotations and XX/YY/ZZ interactions. GHZ, W and Dicke states are defined and their properties explained before constructing reference circuits. The cavity example introduces open evolution, weak measurement and the source feedback-learning result.
